records.name: Establishment and revision of IT security rules
records.name_th: ระเบียบความปลอดภัย IT
records.question: Do rules concerning IT security comply with Marubeni Group IT Governance Rules (ITGR)?
records.standards: ① Must satisfy all of the requirements in “Appendix 1_Rule Requirements,” which is included in the required rules listed in the sample IT security rules
records.evidence_req: ① Rules for IT security
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Local IT security rules exist (v2.1, 2023) but only 6/9 Appendix-1 sections fully covered. Missing: explicit scope statement, CIA-triad definition, drill cadence for targeted-attack email exercises.
records.finding_th: นโยบายความปลอดภัย IT (v2.1, 2023) ครอบคลุม 6/9 หัวข้อตาม Appendix-1 เท่านั้น ขาดการกำหนดขอบเขต, CIA triad และความถี่ฝึกซ้อม phishing
evidence_obtained: Policy approval memo signed by MD
records.recommendation: Re-baseline policy against Appendix 1 Rule Requirements; close 3 gaps via Q3-FY26 policy revision.
records.recommendation_th: ปรับปรุงนโยบายตาม Appendix 1 ปิด 3 ช่องว่างภายใน FY26Q3

records.name: Establishment and revision of information asset management rules
records.name_th: ระเบียบจัดการสินทรัพย์สารสนเทศ
records.question: Do rules concerning information asset management comply with Marubeni Group IT Governance Rules (ITGR)?
records.standards: ①Must satisfy all of the requirements in “Appendix 1_Rule Requirements,” which is included in the required rules listed in the sample　information asset management
records.evidence_req: ① Rules for information asset management
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Information Asset Management Rules exist but classification scheme uses only 2 tiers (Internal / Confidential); ITGR requires 'Strictly Confidential' tier with separate handling.
records.finding_th: มีระเบียบฯ v1.4 แต่จำแนกชั้นข้อมูลเพียง 2 ระดับ (Internal/Confidential) ตาม ITGR ต้องมี Strictly Confidential แยกชั้น
records.recommendation: Adopt 3-tier scheme aligned with Appendix-1(2) before next FY external audit.
records.recommendation_th: เพิ่ม 3-tier classification ให้สอดคล้อง Appendix-1(2) ก่อน audit รอบนอกถัดไป

records.question: Are the following defined/appointed persons in accordance with the rules or other documents regarding IT Managers(*)?  1. Roles 2. Individuals (position or full name)  *Individuals responsible for managing company systems and IT devices, ensuring they can be used efficiently, reliably, and maintaining IT security
records.standards: ① Items 1 and 2 (“role” and “individuals”) to the left must be described in a document (rules, etc.) that has gone through an approval process
records.evidence_req: ① Documents describing roles individuals
records.status_label_th: ผ่านมาตรฐาน
records.finding: IT Manager role & appointment formally documented in Org Chart 2025 and signed appointment letter.
records.finding_th: มีหนังสือแต่งตั้งจาก CEO (ม.ค. 2025) และ Org Chart FY25Q2 ครบถ้วน

records.name: Definition and appointment of Information Managers

records.question: Are the following defined/appointed persons in accordance with rules or other documents, regarding Information Managers(*)?  1. Roles 2. Individuals (position or full name)  *Individuals with responsibility and authority for the management of information assets controlled by each department
records.standards: ① Items 1 and 2 (“role” and “individuals”) to the left must be described in a document (rules, etc.) that has gone through an approval process
records.evidence_req: ① Documents describing roles individuals
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Information Manager appointed but JD missing periodic self-inspection duty; no formal delegation matrix.
records.finding_th: มีการแต่งตั้งแต่ JD ไม่ระบุหน้าที่ self-inspection และไม่มี delegation matrix
records.recommendation: Update JD to include §6(2) self-inspection cadence and leakage-response duties.
records.recommendation_th: ปรับ JD เพิ่มภารกิจ self-inspection ตาม §6(2) และหน้าที่รับมือเหตุข้อมูลรั่ว

records.cat_th: 1. ธรรมาภิบาลความปลอดภัย & บุคลากร/กายภาพ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 1 — ธรรมาภิบาล & บุคลากร
records.name: Cloud service selection criteria
records.name_th: เกณฑ์เลือก Cloud Service
records.question: When introducing cloud services, are the security requirements specified by ITGR comprehensively checked, and are decisions on whether or not to introduce cloud services and alternative measures considered, taking into account the importance and confidentiality of the relevant systems?
records.standards: ① Preserve the results of confirming compliance with security requirements at the time of introducing cloud services (e.g., using the cloud risk check sheet). ② Evaluate risks and implement necessary countermeasures for requirements that have not been complied with.
records.evidence_req: ①② Results of security requirements, consideration of alternative measures, etc. ①② If you have established your own cloud service selection criteria, the document
records.status_label_th: ไม่ผ่าน
records.finding: No formal cloud-service selection criteria. SaaS apps (Dropbox, Canva, ChatGPT Team) procured ad-hoc by business units without IT approval workflow.
records.finding_th: ไม่มีเกณฑ์เลือก SaaS อย่างเป็นทางการ Business unit จัดซื้อ Dropbox/Canva/ChatGPT Team เองโดยไม่ผ่าน IT
evidence_obtained: Procurement spend report shows 14 SaaS subscriptions outside IT
records.recommendation: Issue cloud-selection checklist + central SaaS register; route all new SaaS through IT Manager approval.
records.recommendation_th: ออก checklist เลือก cloud + รายการ SaaS กลาง ต้องผ่าน IT Manager อนุมัติทุกตัว

records.cat_th: 1. ธรรมาภิบาลความปลอดภัย & บุคลากร/กายภาพ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 1 — ธรรมาภิบาล & บุคลากร
records.name: Selection of service providers and outsourcing of confidential information management
records.name_th: คัดเลือกผู้ให้บริการ Outsource
records.question: When outsourcing the management of critical systems that contain confidential information, do you select an entity that meets one of the following requirements?  1. ISO27001 certification, and ISO27018(*) certification if personal information is retained. 2. Able to present to clients a SOC2 (type2) audit report showing the results of third-party audits in terms of availability, confidentiality, security, privacy, and integrity 3. 24/365 monitoring, timely application of vulnerability patches, and multiple vulnerability inspections per year 4. Confirmation that the person in charge of informat…
records.standards: 1) One of the requirements in 1, 2, 3, or 4 on the left must be satisfied.
records.evidence_req: ① ISO certification, etc. ① SOC2 reports ② Verification record
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Service-provider selection done for major outsourcing (payroll, hosting) but no due-diligence file for several minor vendors handling employee PII.
records.finding_th: Vendor หลัก (payroll, hosting) มี due-diligence แต่ vendor ย่อยที่ดูแล PII พนักงานยังไม่มีแฟ้ม DD
records.recommendation: Apply outsourcing due-diligence checklist to all vendors processing confidential information.
records.recommendation_th: ใช้ checklist outsourcing DD กับทุก vendor ที่จัดการข้อมูลความลับ

records.cat_th: 1. ธรรมาภิบาลความปลอดภัย & บุคลากร/กายภาพ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 1 — ธรรมาภิบาล & บุคลากร
records.name: Security training for employees
records.name_th: อบรมความปลอดภัยพนักงาน
records.question: Are the following conditions satisfied for employee security training?  1. Conducted upon hiring and then at least once per year 2. Records kept of training attendance history 3. Conducted in a way that ensures that all employees receive training (in a group or by e-learning) and in a way that cannot be skipped, such as simply sending an email 4. Contains a comprehensive list of items that all employees should be aware of on a daily basis
records.standards: ① Must conduct new hire training, and training must be conducted at least once per year, for all employees ② Must save a training attendance history for the above ③ Must make use of methods equivalent to group training and e-learning ④ Must include content equivalent to training material templates provided by Marubeni ⑤ Must review training content at least once a year
records.evidence_req: ①②③ Training history over last year (document listing participants, dates, trainee names, and training procedures) ④⑤ Training content (materials, videos, etc.)
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Annual security e-learning conducted (87% completion FY24). Targeted-attack email drill not performed in last 24 months.
records.finding_th: มี e-learning ปีละครั้ง (FY24 จบ 87%) แต่ไม่มีการซ้อม phishing simulation 24 เดือนที่ผ่านมา
records.recommendation: Schedule phishing-simulation drill ≥1x/year; track click-rate KPI.
records.recommendation_th: จัด phishing drill ≥1 ครั้ง/ปี ติดตาม KPI click-rate

records.cat_th: 1. ธรรมาภิบาลความปลอดภัย & บุคลากร/กายภาพ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 1 — ธรรมาภิบาล & บุคลากร
records.name: Provision and dissemination of IT environments to employees
records.name_th: จัดสภาพแวดล้อม IT ให้พนักงาน
records.question: Are all of the following measures taken after employees are provided with or informed of IT environments (IT devices, software services, network environments, etc.) used for business?  1.Inform employees that, in principle, personal use of the environment and business use other than personal use of the environment (including desktop use of personal PCs and posting of business information on external SNS and websites) are prohibited. 2. Checking alerts and reports on security measures issued by Marubeni and informing employees of them as necessary
records.standards: ① Must train employees or inform them individually about items 1 and 2 to the left
records.evidence_req: ①Training materials or individual memos
records.status_label_th: ผ่านมาตรฐาน
records.finding: Standard image (Windows 11 + M365 + Sophos) deployed via Intune for all new joiners; onboarding checklist signed by HR & IT.
records.finding_th: มี standard image (Win11+M365+Sophos) ผ่าน Intune onboarding checklist ลงนามครบ

records.name: Contracts with internal permanently assigned workers
records.name_th: สัญญากับพนักงานประจำ
records.question: If non-employees (subcontractor employees) are permanently assigned in the company, is all of the following information included in outsourcing contracts, etc.?  1. Confidentiality clause 2. Locus of responsibility in the event of an accident 3. Compliance with laws and rules
records.standards: ① Items 1, 2 and 3 to the left must be contained in the written contracts for outsourcing, etc.
records.evidence_req: ① Contracts for outsourcing, etc.
records.status_label_th: ผ่านมาตรฐาน
records.finding: Employment contracts include confidentiality clause (Art. 17) and IT acceptable-use annex.
records.finding_th: สัญญาจ้างมีข้อ confidentiality (ม.17) และ AUP annex ครบถ้วน

records.cat_th: 1. ธรรมาภิบาลความปลอดภัย & บุคลากร/กายภาพ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 1 — ธรรมาภิบาล & บุคลากร
records.name: Checking and correcting the status of security measures at subsidiaries
records.name_th: ตรวจ-แก้ไขสถานะบริษัทย่อย
records.question: Are the following two actions taken regularly using the ITGR checklist for the maintenance and implementation of information security measures?  1. Self-inspection by subsidiary 2. Confirmation of the status of security measures at subsidiaries and guidance on corrective actions
records.standards: ① Must periodically (approximately once a year) have subsidiaries conduct self-inspections using the ITGR Checklist, etc., provide corrective guidance, and store the results ※Implementation in companies subject to information security assessment is optional.
records.evidence_req: ① Results of self-checks and confirmation/corrective guidance
records.status_label_th: ไม่เกี่ยวข้อง
records.finding: No subsidiary in scope (Autocorp is a single legal entity in this region).
records.finding_th: ไม่มีบริษัทย่อยในขอบเขต (Autocorp เป็นนิติบุคคลเดี่ยว)
records.recommendation: Confirm with HQ that consolidated scope excludes downstream entities.
records.recommendation_th: ยืนยันกับ HQ ว่าขอบเขตไม่รวมหน่วยงานปลายน้ำ

records.cat_th: 1. ธรรมาภิบาลความปลอดภัย & บุคลากร/กายภาพ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 1 — ธรรมาภิบาล & บุคลากร
records.name: Entry/exit management for business facilities and offices
records.name_th: ควบคุมเข้า-ออกอาคาร
records.question: Are all of the following implemented with regard to entry/exit management for business facilities and offices?  1. Entry/exit restrictions and locking (authentication by IC card, etc.) 2. Records kept for entry/exit, locking, etc. (date and time, ID on employee identification card, etc.)
records.standards: ① Must implement items 1 and 2 to the left in business locations and offices where confidential information is handled
records.evidence_req: ① Photos of IC card authentication devices, locks, etc. ① Logs
records.status_label_th: ผ่านมาตรฐาน
records.finding: Office entry/exit controlled by HID card reader; visitor log book at reception; CCTV retained 30 days.
records.finding_th: ใช้ HID card reader, ทะเบียนผู้มาเยือน และ CCTV เก็บ 30 วัน

records.cat_th: 1. ธรรมาภิบาลความปลอดภัย & บุคลากร/กายภาพ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 1 — ธรรมาภิบาล & บุคลากร
records.name: Entry/exit management for server rooms, etc.
records.name_th: ควบคุมเข้า-ออกห้อง Server
records.question: Are all of the following implemented for locations where server/network devices are installed (internal server rooms, data centers, etc.)?  1. Entry/exit restrictions (authentication by ID card, etc.) and locking 2. Entry/exit records (take entry/exit logs, etc.)
records.standards: ① Must implement entry/exit restrictions and locking at all installation locations ② Must keep entry/exit records
records.evidence_req: ① Photos of ID card authentication devices, locks, etc., or reports issued by data centers, etc. ① Logs
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Server room access restricted to 4 named IT staff. However, access log review not performed periodically; spare key in unlocked drawer.
records.finding_th: จำกัด IT 4 คน แต่ไม่ทบทวน log เป็นระยะ และพบกุญแจสำรองในลิ้นชักที่ไม่ล็อก
records.recommendation: Move spare key to keyed cabinet; institute monthly access-log review by IT Manager.
records.recommendation_th: ย้ายกุญแจไปตู้ล็อก, IT Manager ทบทวน access log รายเดือน

records.cat_th: 2. การจัดการบัญชีผู้ใช้
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 2 — บัญชีผู้ใช้
records.name: Access permission control for important systems
records.name_th: สิทธิ์เข้าระบบสำคัญ
records.question: Is there a system for controlling access permissions based on affiliation, job title, work, etc. (browse, update, delete, etc. digital information) for critical systems(*)?  *Systems (file storage, email servers, authentication servers, systems that hold strictly confidential information, systems subject to IT general control, important infrastructure systems, etc.) where compromised confidentiality, integrity, or availability could result in serious consequences for the operations of the organization
records.standards: ① Must implement access permission control systems for all important systems
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of access permission configuration screens, etc.
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: AD groups used for SAP and ERP access; however 3 admins share 'sa' DB account; approval workflow informal (email only).
records.finding_th: ใช้ AD group กับ SAP/ERP แต่ admin 3 คนใช้ DB account "sa" ร่วมกัน อนุมัติทำเฉพาะอีเมล
records.recommendation: Eliminate shared 'sa' account; deploy ticket-based approval (ServiceDesk Plus).
records.recommendation_th: ยกเลิก shared sa, ใช้ ticket-based approval ผ่าน ServiceDesk Plus

records.name_th: สิทธิ์เข้าระบบอื่น
records.question: Is there a system for browsing, updating, and deleting digital information according to access permissions for systems other than important systems?
records.standards: ① Must implement access permission control systems for all systems other than important systems
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of access permission configuration screens, etc.
records.status_label_th: ผ่านมาตรฐาน
records.finding: Role-based access via AD groups for file shares and intranet apps.
records.finding_th: ใช้ role-based access ผ่าน AD group กับ file share และ intranet app

records.cat_th: 2. การจัดการบัญชีผู้ใช้
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 2 — บัญชีผู้ใช้
records.name: Account and access permission approval for important systems
records.name_th: อนุมัติสิทธิ์ระบบสำคัญ
records.question: Are all of the following procedures implemented for issuing, changing, and deleting accounts and access privileges for critical systems?  1. General accounts are authorized by the Information Manager, and administrator accounts are authorized by the IT Manager. 2. A record of the above authorizations are retained for at least a year. 3. All of the following requirements for the scope and separation of authority are met.     1) The scope of access permissions is limited according to affiliation and position.     2) The requester and approver of account access permissions are separate.     3) ID…
records.standards: ① Must establish procedures that satisfy items 1, 2, 3, and 4 to the left for all important systems ② Operations must be in accordance with the procedures mentioned above
records.evidence_req: ① Documents describing procedures ② Application/approval records (within most recent year)
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: New-hire account creation requires HR + IT-Manager approval; modification & deletion follow same path but turnover SLA averages 9 days for leavers (target ≤3).
records.finding_th: New-hire ต้องอนุมัติ HR+IT Manager แต่ผู้ลาออกเฉลี่ย 9 วันจึงตัดสิทธิ์ (เป้าหมาย ≤3)
records.recommendation: Automate leaver provisioning via HRIS-to-AD connector; SLA target ≤24h.
records.recommendation_th: อัตโนมัติ leaver provisioning ผ่าน HRIS-to-AD, SLA ≤24 ชม.

records.finding_th: ปัญหาเดียวกับ #15 และพบ intranet app บางตัวยัง self-register ได้เอง

records.recommendation_th: ปิด self-registration บน intranet, รวม IAM ที่ส่วนกลาง

records.recommendation_th: จัด quarterly access recertification สำหรับ SAP, AD, M365 ตำแหน่ง admin/finance

records.recommendation_th: ขยาย recertification ทุกระบบรอบปี

records.name: Account sharing restrictions
records.name_th: ห้ามใช้บัญชีร่วม
records.question: Is account sharing generally prohibited? If accounts must be shared, are the following implemented?  1. All shared accounts are known 2. There are valid reasons for sharing, and it is clear why and by whom these accounts are used 3. The use of environments is limited to listed users, or logs are checked after usage 4. If accounts are shared temporarily (for outsourced maintenance, etc.), accounts are shared only with required users and passwords are changed whenever the account is no longer shared
records.standards: ① There must be no shared accounts, or items 1, 2, 3, and 4 to the left must be performed for all general and administrator accounts ② Must periodically review the suitability of shared accounts (whether to use shared accounts or not, and who will use them)
records.evidence_req: ① Records of account sharing reasons, uses, users, and environments ① Records of temporary account lending ② Results of reviewing suitability
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Shared accounts identified for 2 maintenance use-cases (printer admin, CCTV NVR). Password not rotated after each maintenance window.
records.finding_th: พบ shared account 2 รายการ (printer admin, CCTV NVR) ไม่หมุน password หลัง maintenance
records.recommendation: Document business reason; rotate password after each vendor session; log usage.
records.recommendation_th: บันทึกเหตุผลธุรกิจ, หมุน password หลัง vendor session, log การใช้

records.cat_th: 2. การจัดการบัญชีผู้ใช้

records.name: Disabling or deleting unnecessary accounts
records.name_th: ปิด/ลบบัญชีไม่ใช้
records.question: Are all of the following measures taken in relation to disabling or deleting accounts that are unnecessary for business operations?   1. Making an account unavailable by the last day of service in the case of an employee or the day the contract expires in the case of a subcontractor, etc. 2. Disabling or deleting an inactive account after a certain period of inactivity
records.standards: ① Must delete the accounts of all employees who leave the company and persons whose service contract is expiring, using one of the following methods • Automatically delete or disable on the day the employee leaves or the day the contract expires • Manually delete immediately after the retirement date or the contract expiration date (If it is difficult to delete on the same day, it is necessary to disable access by the account and invalidate or delete at an appropriate time such as monthly review) ② Must establish and follow procedures that satisfy item 2 to the left
records.evidence_req: ①② List of deleted/disabled accounts (within most recent year) ① List of employees who have left the company and persons whose service contracts have expired (within most recent year) ② Document that contains the procedures
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: 30-day inactive disable policy exists in AD GPO; not enforced on SAP or HRIS — 14 leaver accounts found active >90 days.
records.finding_th: AD GPO ตั้ง 30-day inactive แต่ SAP/HRIS ไม่บังคับ พบ 14 บัญชี leaver active เกิน 90 วัน
records.recommendation: Apply same 30-day rule across SAP / HRIS; monthly leaver reconciliation.
records.recommendation_th: ใช้กฎ 30 วันกับ SAP/HRIS, reconcile leaver รายเดือน

records.question: Does the password policy for PCs and servers in an AD (Active Directory) environment meet all requirements listed in “Appendix 2_List of Password Requirements”?
records.standards: ① Passwords for PCs in an AD environment must satisfy the requirements in "Appendix 2_List of Password Requirements" ② Passwords for servers in an AD environment must satisfy the requirements in "Appendix 2_List of Password Requirements"

records.status_label_th: ผ่านมาตรฐาน

records.cat_th: 2. การจัดการบัญชีผู้ใช้

records.name: Password Management
records.name_th: การจัดการรหัสผ่าน admin
records.question: Are all of the following measures taken in order to prevent a password from being known to anyone other than its user?  1. Require initial password change at first login 　　1) Provide a function to force a password change for the first time use. 　　2) If the above is not possible due to the system specifications, the system will inform the customer to change the password to one that only the customer knows at the time of issuance or at some other point in time. 2. Informing only the user of their password. 3. Masking passwords when users type them in (masking password characters with asterisks, …
records.standards: ① PCs participating in AD must have their initial passwords changed ② Servers participating in AD must have their initial passwords changed ③ Must implement item 1 to the left for all passwords for individual systems (requesting that users change initial passwords) ④ Must maintain a practice that meets item 2 to the left ⑤ Must maintain a function that meets item 3 to the left
records.evidence_req: ①②Screenshot of AD account setup screen ③Screenshot of password change request screen or text of email inviting the change ④ Email notifications ⑤ Screenshots of password setting screens
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Admin passwords stored in shared KeePass vault; vault password known to 4 staff; no rotation policy.
records.finding_th: password admin เก็บใน KeePass ที่ใช้รหัสร่วม 4 คน ไม่มี rotation policy
records.recommendation: Deploy enterprise PAM (e.g., CyberArk SaaS / Delinea); rotate quarterly; audit usage.
records.recommendation_th: ใช้ enterprise PAM (CyberArk/Delinea), หมุนรายไตรมาส, audit การใช้งาน

records.recommendation_th: ส่ง SAP log ไป SIEM, retention ≥1 ปี

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures

records.name: Log acquisition and storage for PCs
records.name_th: Log PC
records.question: Have all of the following logs been obtained and stored for at least one year for company-owned PCs?  1. Logs are obtained and stored as per "Appendix 3_Logging and Storage Requirements List". 2.The above logs must include the date and time that satisfy the following ・Same time setting in the system ・UTC in principle, but time zone is also required when it is unavoidable
records.standards: ①All items 1 and 2 on the left must be kept for at least one year for all PCs.
records.evidence_req: ① Log configuration screens ① Logs (actual logs)
records.status_label_th: ไม่ผ่าน
records.finding: PC event logs not collected centrally; Sophos has 90d cloud retention only.
records.finding_th: event log บน PC ไม่ได้รวมที่ส่วนกลาง Sophos เก็บ cloud 90 วัน
records.recommendation: Onboard endpoint logs to SIEM (per #56).
records.recommendation_th: onboard endpoint log เข้า SIEM (ตาม #56)

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Backup acquisition and storage for important systems
records.name_th: Backup ระบบสำคัญ
records.question: For critical systems (including cloud services), are all of the following implemented?  1. Backups are taken and stored at appropriate schedules and times using an appropriate generation policy 2. Store backup data in a segment that is separate from the system to restrict communication with that system except for backup operations(*)   *Including storage to a cloud backup service and physical storage using external storage media
records.standards: ① All important systems must satisfy items 1 and 2 to the left ② The frequency and method of backup must be appropriate in regard to the confidentiality and importance of stored information
records.evidence_req: ①② Backup configuration screen, service specifications and backup design documents, and configuration information of devices such as routers and firewalls (FW) installed between segments
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Backups: SAP daily full + 4h log, retention 30d on-site + weekly off-site (Veeam to Wasabi). No tested off-site restore in last 12 months.
records.finding_th: SAP backup full ทุกวัน + log 4 ชม., retention 30d on-site + off-site รายสัปดาห์ (Veeam→Wasabi) ไม่ได้ทดสอบ restore off-site 12 เดือนที่ผ่านมา
records.recommendation: Quarterly restore test from off-site copy; document RTO/RPO.
records.recommendation_th: ทดสอบ restore จาก off-site รายไตรมาส, เอกสาร RTO/RPO

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Backup restore procedures for important systems
records.name_th: Restore procedure
records.question: Are backup recovery procedures in place for important systems?
records.standards: ① Must establish backup recovery procedures for all important systems
records.evidence_req: ① Backup restore procedures
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Restore procedure documented for SAP & file server; not for HRIS or CRM.
records.finding_th: มีขั้นตอน restore SAP + file server ไม่มีของ HRIS/CRM
records.recommendation: Extend runbook to HRIS, CRM; tabletop test.
records.recommendation_th: ขยาย runbook ไป HRIS/CRM, tabletop test

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Monitoring and handling of endpoint terminals
records.name_th: Monitor/จัดการ Endpoint
records.question: Has EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) been implemented in a manner that satisfies "Appendix 4: Detection Scenario List" in order to collect and monitor endpoint logs in real-time and respond to threats when they are detected?
records.standards: ① Any EDR products used must satisfy requirements listed in "Appendix 4: Detection Scenario List"
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of management screens, etc.
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Sophos Intercept-X EDR licensed but alert tuning incomplete; no 24/7 monitoring (business-hours triage only).
records.finding_th: Sophos Intercept-X EDR มี license แต่ tuning ยังไม่สมบูรณ์ ไม่มี 24/7 monitor (เวลา business เท่านั้น)
records.recommendation: Consider MDR service (Sophos MDR or third-party SOC) for 24/7.
records.recommendation_th: พิจารณา MDR (Sophos MDR หรือ SOC ภายนอก) เพื่อ 24/7

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Incident monitoring, analysis, and response organizations
records.name_th: องค์กรเฝ้าระวังเหตุการณ์ 24/7
records.question: Are the following implemented with regard to security event monitoring, analysis, and response?  1. There is a 24 hour, 365 day monitoring/response team 2. Either a) or b) applies to individuals responsible for monitoring and analysis 　　a) Individuals with experience in SOC-related work 　　b) Qualified IT security-related personnel with experience in IT security-related operations 3. Individuals responsible for providing responses have experience in IT security-related work
records.standards: ① Must ensure there is a 24 hour, 365 day response organization ② Must include individuals mentioned in items 2 and 3 to the left for said organization are qualified (relevant qualifications include the following) • CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) • GSEC/GCIH/GCIA: GIAC Security Certifications • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
records.evidence_req: ① Organization charts ② Member profiles (experience, skills, years of experience, etc.)
records.status_label_th: ไม่ผ่าน
records.finding: No formal 24/7 incident-monitoring organisation; reliance on Sophos auto-response + IT-Manager email alerts.
records.finding_th: ไม่มีองค์กร 24/7 อย่างเป็นทางการ พึ่ง Sophos auto-response + อีเมลแจ้ง IT Manager
records.recommendation: Either internal SOC (>2 FTE) or contract MDR per #79.
records.recommendation_th: มี SOC ภายใน (>2 FTE) หรือทำสัญญา MDR ตาม #79

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Log monitoring and correlation analysis
records.name_th: Log Correlation Analysis
records.question: Are all of the following implemented with regard to log monitoring and analysis?  1. Endpoint and network device logs are collected in real-time 2. SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) has been implemented 3. Standards have been established for analyzing detected logs and critical (requiring immediate action) logs are always reviewed 4. Confirmation whether operations are being performed appropriately based on the standards above are conducted at least once per year
records.standards: ① Must introduce SIEM products with the functionality indicated in item 1 to the left and "Appendix 4: Detection Scenario List" ② Must store the results of reviews and audits described in items 3 and 4 to the left
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of SIEM management screens, log analysis standards, etc. ② Review / confirmation results (within most recent year)
records.status_label_th: ไม่ผ่าน
records.finding: No SIEM correlation; manual log review only.
records.finding_th: ไม่มี SIEM correlation อาศัยการดู log แบบ manual
records.recommendation: Stand up Sentinel/Wazuh; baseline correlation rules from Appendix-3.
records.recommendation_th: ตั้ง Sentinel/Wazuh, baseline correlation rule ตาม Appendix-3

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Rule modeling/tuning for SIEM, etc.
records.name_th: Rule tuning SIEM
records.question: Are product detection/analysis rule modeling and tuning for SIEM, etc. performed based on the latest security threat information and for past over-detection or false detection incidents?
records.standards: ① Must implement functionality to analyze correlation from multiple log sources and identify security threats, such as a SIEM function ② Must tune rules as needed in a timely manner
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of correlation analysis screens ② Screenshots of rule configuration screens ② Tuning history for rules (minutes of review meetings, etc.)
records.status_label_th: ไม่ผ่าน
records.finding: No SIEM → no rule tuning.
records.finding_th: ไม่มี SIEM จึงไม่มี tuning
records.recommendation: Linked to #81.
records.recommendation_th: เชื่อมกับ #81

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Initial response time when malware is detected
records.name_th: เวลาตอบสนองเมื่อพบ malware
records.question: When a threat such as malware is detected, is there a target response time set in advance (from when the alert is detected until the endpoint is isolated from the network)?
records.standards: ① Must set an appropriate target response time from when detection occurs to when provisional measures are begun (approximately within three hours)  ② The actual time from when detection occurs to when remediation begins must be within the target response time according to incident reports
records.evidence_req: ① SLA/operation design documents, etc. (describing target response times) ② Most recent incident response report
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Malware detection triggers Sophos auto-isolate; mean response by analyst ~4h (ITGR target: 'promptly').
records.finding_th: Sophos auto-isolate เมื่อพบ malware นักวิเคราะห์ตอบสนองเฉลี่ย 4 ชม. (ITGR เป้า "ทันท่วงที")
records.recommendation: Define numerical SLA (≤1h triage) and on-call rotation.
records.recommendation_th: กำหนด SLA เป็นตัวเลข (≤1 ชม. triage) + on-call rotation

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Preparations for responding when a security incident occurs
records.name_th: เตรียมรับมือเหตุการณ์
records.question: In regard to responding to when a security incident is detected, has a response procedure been prepared that includes the following  1. Initial actions and internal reports when an incident occurs; division of responsibilities, identification of scope of impact, etc. 2. Procedures for isolating from authentication servers and distribution servers shared with neighboring networks or other companies to prevent the spread of damage (spread of malware infection, etc.) 3. Report to M-CSIRT 4. Report to Marubeni's main department
records.standards: ① Must establish response procedures for items 1, 2, 3, and 4 to the left ②Training based on the relevant response procedures (verification of whether the procedures can be implemented according to the procedures) should be conducted on a regular basis.
records.evidence_req: ① Response procedure documents ②Training record
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Incident response plan v1.0 (2022) exists; not updated post-ransomware tabletop (Aug 2024 finding).
records.finding_th: มี IRP v1.0 (2022) ยังไม่อัปเดตหลัง ransomware tabletop (ส.ค. 2024)
records.recommendation: Refresh IRP; incorporate AAR; quarterly tabletops.
records.recommendation_th: รีเฟรช IRP, รวม AAR, tabletop รายไตรมาส

records.cat: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
records.cat_th: 7. การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์ & ความขัดข้อง
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 7 — เหตุการณ์
records.name: Reporting and responding when a security incident occurs
records.name_th: รายงาน/รับมือเหตุการณ์
records.question: Are the following operations conducted in accordance with the "Reporting Guideline for Security Incidents" and the "(same) Guideline for Response"?  1.Inform and implement reporting to the M-CSIRT and Marubeni's main department. 2. All of the following responses are implemented and recorded in the incident report   1) Analysis/containment   2) Eradication/restoration   3) Prevention of recurrence
records.standards: ① Disseminate the contents of 1 on the left. ② Must implement items 1 and 2 to the left when an incident occurs and must record this in incident response reports
records.evidence_req: ① Memos ② Most recent incident response report
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Reporting line: IT Manager → MD → Group HQ-IT. No defined timing SLA.
records.finding_th: รายงานสาย IT Manager → MD → Group HQ-IT, ไม่มี SLA เวลาที่กำหนด
records.recommendation: Adopt Marubeni HQ-IT 24h initial report + 72h follow-up SLA.
records.recommendation_th: ใช้ SLA Marubeni HQ-IT 24 ชม. initial + 72 ชม. follow-up

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Security measures for file storage
records.name_th: ความปลอดภัย File Storage
records.question: Are all of the following implemented for file storage that includes confidential information (all information assets except public information or information that could be made public)?  1. Access from the command line is controlled 2. Two-factor authentication 3. Controls are in place to prevent access using the AD administrator account (separate file storage administrator and AD administrator accounts) 4. Recorded logs cannot be deleted or changed even by system administrators 5. All files in storage are encrypted 6. Communication with file storage is encrypted
records.standards: ① File storage that is being used must satisfy items 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 to the left
records.evidence_req: ① File storage configuration screens, service specifications, responses from vendors, etc.
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: File server (Windows DFS) + M365 SharePoint Online; permissions reviewed annually for top-level only.
records.finding_th: File server (DFS Windows) + M365 SharePoint, ทบทวนสิทธิ์รายปีเฉพาะระดับ top
records.recommendation: Add quarterly review of sub-site & breakglass permissions.
records.recommendation_th: เพิ่มทบทวนรายไตรมาสของ sub-site และ breakglass

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Designation and dissemination of confidential information
records.name_th: ระบุ/สื่อสารข้อมูลความลับ
records.question: Are information assets and their level of confidentiality, containing department, etc. listed as confidential information, and disseminated to employees?
records.standards: ① Must inform employees of the list described to the left (reference material: Appendix 5_Information Asset Management Standards Sample) ② Must periodically review list above
records.evidence_req: ① Memos (rules, training materials, individual memos, etc.) ② Records of reviews
records.status_label_th: ไม่ผ่าน
records.finding: Confidential information not labelled. No use of M365 Sensitivity Labels.
records.finding_th: ไม่มีการ label ข้อมูลความลับ ไม่ได้ใช้ M365 Sensitivity Labels
records.recommendation: Roll out Purview Sensitivity Labels (Internal / Confidential / Strictly Confidential).
records.recommendation_th: ใช้ Purview Sensitivity Labels (Internal/Confidential/Strictly Confidential)

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Storage and saving of confidential information
records.name_th: เก็บรักษาข้อมูลความลับ
records.question: Are all of the following implemented regarding storing and saving confidential information?  1. In principle, store and save data in high-security file storage, not in PCs or external storage media. (In the event that a file server, etc., other than a high-security storage is used, the Information Manager must confirm that it does not contain confidential information. 2. Strictly confidential information(*) is separately stored/saved in folders, etc. from other information assets.  *An information asset that would have a serious impact on business management and operations, or information enti…
records.standards: ①Must inform employees of the left operation rule ②Must provide dedicated storage areas by default for all strictly confidential information (folders, etc.) ③ Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
records.evidence_req: ①Evidence that informing employees of the statement left has been done ② Screenshots of screens showing exclusive storage locations for strictly confidential information
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Confidential data lives in SharePoint Confidential site; Strictly Confidential tier not separated.
records.finding_th: ข้อมูลความลับอยู่ใน SharePoint Confidential site, Strictly Confidential tier ไม่แยก
records.recommendation: Create Strictly Confidential vault with restricted membership + DLP enforcement.
records.recommendation_th: สร้าง Strictly Confidential vault สมาชิกจำกัด + DLP

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Default access permissions for file storage
records.name_th: ค่าเริ่มต้นสิทธิ์ File Storage
records.question: Are all of the following implemented with regard to access rights which is granted by default in strictly secure file storage?  1. Strictly confidential information is restricted to certain employees of the managing department (officers, etc., in the department) 2. Confidential information that is not highly confidential is restricted to employees in the managing department
records.standards: ① Must set permissions satisfying items 1 and 2 to the left by default for all storage locations for confidential information (folders, etc.) ② Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of access permission configuration screens for folders
records.status_label_th: ผ่านมาตรฐาน
records.finding: Default deny on new SharePoint sites; folder-level inheritance documented.
records.finding_th: SharePoint default deny กับ site ใหม่, folder-level inheritance มีเอกสาร

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Individual permission approval and review
records.name_th: อนุมัติ/ทบทวนสิทธิ์รายบุคคล
records.question: When it is unavoidable for business reasons to allow access to confidential information by those other than users provided with access permissions by default, are the following implemented to limit access to the minimum level necessary, and only temporarily?  1. User accessible information assets, and operations (editing, downloading, etc.) can be limited 2. Granted and changed with the approval of an Information Manager (at least once per month for post-approval) 3. Permissions are reviewed at least twice per year and the results are reviwed and approved by an Information Manager
records.standards: ① Must provide file storage with functionality to perform items 1, 2, and 3 to the left ② Must store results for items 2 and 3 to the left
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of screens for granting individual permissions, or service specifications, manuals, etc. ② Approval/review records
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Individual access requests via email; approval recorded inconsistently.
records.finding_th: ขออนุมัติทางอีเมล บันทึกไม่สม่ำเสมอ
records.recommendation: Move to ticket-based approval with manager + Info-Manager dual sign-off.
records.recommendation_th: ใช้ ticket-based approval, dual sign-off จาก manager + Info Manager

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Means of sharing confidential information outside the company
records.name_th: แชร์ข้อมูลความลับนอกบริษัท
records.question: Is confidential digital information shared outside the company only with certain other organizations, etc., and stored/saved in highly secure file storage? (Sharing through email attachments is generally prohibited even if passwords are set and attachments are encrypted)
records.standards: ① Must provide functionality (sharing links, etc.) to share data on file storage outside of the company ② Must provide functionality to prevent external sharing via email attachments or implement equivalent operations manually ③ Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of sharing function screens (sharing links, etc.) ② Screenshots of email attachment control function screens, or evidence that informing employees
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: External sharing via OneDrive blocked by default; SharePoint allows authenticated guests — no Sensitivity Label gate.
records.finding_th: OneDrive block external sharing default, SharePoint อนุญาต authenticated guest โดยไม่ผ่าน Sensitivity Label
records.recommendation: Require Sensitivity Label before sharing externally; expire links 30d.
records.recommendation_th: บังคับ Sensitivity Label ก่อนแชร์ภายนอก, link หมดอายุ 30 วัน

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Detection of removal of confidential information from file storage
records.name_th: ตรวจจับการนำข้อมูลออก
records.question: Are the following operations, which have a high possibility of inappropriate removal from highly secure file storage, detected by logs, etc. and notified to Information Manager, and does the manager instruct the subordinate to take action as necessary?  1. Granting access permissions to accounts that are highly likely to be for personal use (e.g., free email addresses) 2. An external user downloading a large number of files in a short period of time
records.standards: ① Must provide a system for file storage to immediately notify Information Managers when operations described in items 1 and 2 to the left are performed ② Information Managers must store records of confirming these notifications ③ Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
records.evidence_req: ① Detection emails ② Records of checking detection emails
records.status_label_th: ไม่ผ่าน
records.finding: No DLP / CASB monitoring of confidential data movement.
records.finding_th: ไม่มี DLP/CASB monitoring สำหรับ confidential data movement
records.recommendation: Enable M365 DLP (built-in policies first) and Defender for Cloud Apps.
records.recommendation_th: เปิด M365 DLP (built-in policy ก่อน) + Defender for Cloud Apps

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Prevention of loss of crucial information, etc. in file storage
records.name_th: ป้องกันสูญหายของข้อมูล
records.question: Are the following implemented to prevent the loss of confidential information and information that must stored for a certain period of time from file storage due to internal and external negligence, etc.?  1. Functions are in place or used to prevent employees from completely deleting information, etc. (such as deleting information from the recycle bin) 2. Functions are in place or used to prevent information, etc. from being deleted before the retention period expires
records.standards: ① Must provide functionality to perform items 1 and 2 to the left, or must establish and disseminate operational procedures ② Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
records.evidence_req: ① Screenshots of configuration screens ① Memos (when responding with operations)
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Backup covers file storage daily; no immutable backup against ransomware.
records.finding_th: backup file storage รายวัน แต่ไม่มี immutable backup ป้องกัน ransomware
records.recommendation: Enable Veeam immutability flag + Wasabi Object Lock.
records.recommendation_th: เปิด Veeam immutability flag + Wasabi Object Lock

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Measures to prevent leakage of confidential information
records.name_th: ป้องกัน leak confidential
records.question: Are all of the following measures taken to prevent leakage of confidential information?  1. All of the following measures are taken to prevent information leakage from high-security file storage due to unauthorized access by internal/external parties or negligence.  1) Functions are in place or used to restrict downloading, moving, and copying of individual files  2) Functions are in place or used to add digital watermarks to files 2. As a general rule, the removal (including printing, creating other duplicates, or transferring data outside of the Company control) of confidential information i…
records.standards: ① Must provide functionality to restrict downloading, moving, and copying individual files by external users, or must implement equivalent operations ② Equipped with a function (digital watermark, etc.) to prevent unauthorized removal, or to implement an operation equivalent to it. ③ Inform all employees of the security measures described on the left ④ Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
records.evidence_req: ① Configuration screen screenshots, or service specifications, etc. ② Screenshots of screens such as digital watermarks ①②(If it is supported by operation) Memos ③Memos
records.status_label_th: ไม่ผ่าน
records.finding: No DLP, no UEBA — confidential leak prevention informal.
records.finding_th: ไม่มี DLP/UEBA, การป้องกัน leak ยังไม่เป็นทางการ
records.recommendation: Implement Purview DLP for email + SharePoint + endpoint as Phase 1.
records.recommendation_th: Phase 1: Purview DLP สำหรับ email + SharePoint + endpoint

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Management of confidential documents
records.name_th: จัดการเอกสาร confidential
records.question: Are all of the following implemented for the management of paper documents, electromagnetic storage media, etc. containing confidential information?  1.As a rule, store and save in a lockable place. 2. When a document specified as strictly confidential is to be taken out of the office, evidence of such removal is managed using a ledger.
records.standards: ① Must store confidential documents, etc. in locations that can be locked (safes, lockers, storehouses, etc.) ②Must maintain a record of strictly confidential documents taken out of the office
records.evidence_req: ① Photos of storage locations for confidential documents, etc. ②A record of strictly confidential documents taken out of the office
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Confidential paper documents stored in locked filing cabinets per dept; central register absent.
records.finding_th: เอกสารกระดาษเก็บในตู้ล็อกแต่ละแผนก ไม่มีทะเบียนกลาง
records.recommendation: Establish central register; annual stock-take.
records.recommendation_th: จัดทะเบียนกลาง, stock-take รายปี

records.cat_th: 8. การจัดการสารสนเทศที่เป็นความลับ
records.cat_short_th: หมวด 8 — สารสนเทศ
records.name: Means of sharing confidential documents, etc.
records.name_th: ช่องทางแชร์เอกสาร confidential
records.question: Is a method that allows users and recipients of documents to be identified and for the transfer status to be confirmed, when sharing paper documents and electromagnetic storage media containing confidential information?
records.standards: ① Must share confidential documents, etc. in a manner that allows handlers and recipients to be identified and to confirm the transfer status, etc. (registered mail, internal mail, hand delivery, etc.)
records.evidence_req: ① Records sent by registered mail, internal mail, etc.
records.status_label_th: ผ่านบางส่วน
records.finding: Sharing of confidential documents by hand-carry or courier with receipt; some teams email PDFs without encryption.
records.finding_th: แชร์ด้วย hand-carry/courier มีใบรับ บางทีมส่ง PDF ทางอีเมลโดยไม่เข้ารหัส
records.recommendation: Mandate encrypted PDF or secure portal for external sharing of confidential docs.
records.recommendation_th: บังคับ encrypted PDF หรือ secure portal สำหรับแชร์เอกสาร confidential ภายนอก
